contexts.text: The Angels perceive, in the Word spiritual and celestial things altogether abstractedly from the words.
Occurs. AC 1361:4. AC 1547. AC 1644. AC 1787:2. DLW 1. DLW 42. DLW 155. DLW 196. DLW 209.
Drawn away by various matters of business...
Goods, when spoken of abstractedly, are in a subject.
In the abstract sense. AC 2233.
It is spiritual to comprehend things abstractedly from the letter...
Knowledges and truths are not abstract things. Explained.
By the affection of genuine love, man is drawn away from bodily and worldly things.
Man's state there is like that of those who are in interior thought through the abstraction of their mind from sensuous outward things.
In Heaven they think and speak thus by abstract things because... To speak thus was also habitual to the Ancients. AC 9396, Explained.
The taking away of their delight from falsity.
When this ultimate truth is taken away.

This can be said abstractedly concerning the Lord... but with man it cannot be conceived abstractedly from person, because... Yet if that which is comprehensible is abstracted, there remains the Esse and Existere itself.
However, as man is such that he can have no idea whatever of abstract things unless he adjoins somewhat natural...
In the other life, especially in the Heavens, all thought and thence all speech are effected by things abstracted from persons... AC 6040:2, Explained. AC 6653, Explained. AC 8843:end. AC 9007.
In the inward sense all things are abstracted from persons.
Reflection about any people etc. draws away the mind from a universal idea.
The thought that is above the imagination requires for its objects things abstracted from material things.
Wherefore do ye Moses and Aaron draw away the people from their works? To draw away = to release.
Gain = what draws away from truth and good.
When things abstracted from their subjects are spoken of, the subjects in which they are, are perceived.

Abstract speech, that is, speech separated from man, is angelic speech... When they think abstractly about a thing, the thought diffuses itself on every side according to the heavenly form... In a word, abstract thought is able to go through universal Heaven without hindrance, but thought determined to a person or place is fixed and stationary.
The Word in the abstract sense has things for objects, without determination to persons and places.
It is said in the abstract sense, because the Angels, who are in the inward sense of the Word, think and speak abstractedly from person. References.
He who cannot think intellectually, that is, abstractedly from material things, cannot comprehend anything of the spiritual sense.

What is natural keeps the mind fixed in itself, unless the intellectual sight can be elevated even into the light of Heaven and man can think almost abstractedly from natural things; when this is done, spiritual things enter that are imperceptible to the merely natural man.

It is said abstractedly from persons, because the Divine things that proceed from the Lord make the Church, and nothing whatever of man's... This is why the Angels speak abstractedly from persons when they converse together. AC 3767.
They who think abstractedly from the body, being then in the spirit, sometimes appear in their own society. Described.
They who live abstractedly from worldly things are inflamed with merit...
To think spiritually is to think of things in themselves... and to see the qualities of things and perceive their affections abstractedly from matter...
Abstracted from what is natural...
Abstract space, and deny a vacuum, and then think... with space abstracted.

The mere knowledge of abstract things is like something aerial that flies away, but if abstract things are applied to what is in the world, they are like what is seen with the eyes and remains in the memory.

From the fact that will and understanding, affection and thought etc. can be thought of abstractedly from the substances that are their subjects, it has come to pass that a just idea about them has perished... Sensations and actions are not things abstracted from the organs of sense and motion; abstracted or separated from them they are nothing but entities of reason...
Abstract things, being universal, are usually better comprehended than applied ones. Explained.
What is infinite and eternal... can be comprehended, because there are abstract ideas by which it can be seen that things are, though not what is their quality...
The spiritual sense is abstracted from persons. AR 96.
There are no abstract goods and truths. Explained.
You have formed an idea of what is spiritual abstracted from what is material, and that which is abstracted from what is material appears to you as nothing. TCR 694:2.
Into this delirium is the man let after death who has abstracted his spirit from the body...
Love abstracted from a form is not possible.
He can indeed revolve the end and the cause abstractedly in the mind...
The idea that those who are religious are recluses.
Truths abstracted from deeds are merely matters of thought...
So far he is drawn away from what is his own...
In a sense abstracted from persons...
They love what is within man abstractedly from what is without him.
Why Jehovah did not draw away Adam from eating.
Abstractedly from man's power of will in spiritual things, Holy Scripture is so much blank paper.
In the abstract sense, which is the genuine spiritual sense.
